program:
app "Chess clock" clock ink
state t1 dur = 300s
state t2 dur = 300s
state turn num = 0
every 1s if turn = 1 set t1 = t1 - 1s
every 1s if turn = 2 set t2 = t2 - 1s
grid 1 gap 2
  stack card align center pad 4 fill if(turn = 1, accent, soft) tap set turn = 2
    "Player 1" faint
    t1 big color if(t1 < 60s, bad, ink)
  stack card align center pad 4 fill if(turn = 2, accent, soft) tap set turn = 1
    "Player 2" faint
    t2 big color if(t2 < 60s, bad, ink)
button "Pause" tap set turn = 0
button "Reset" tap set turn = 0 then set t1 = 300s then set t2 = 300s
describe:
Chess clock, in the ink colours.
Remembers while you use it: t1, starting at 5 minutes; t2, starting at 5 minutes; turn, starting at 0.
Shows:
- every 1 seconds while turn is 1, it sets t1 to t1 minus 1 seconds.
- every 1 seconds while turn is 2, it sets t2 to t2 minus 1 seconds.
- a grid of 1 columns:
  - a group; a tap sets turn to 2:
    - text: "Player 1".
    - text: t1.
  - a group; a tap sets turn to 1:
    - text: "Player 2".
    - text: t2.
- a button "Pause"; a tap sets turn to 0.
- a button "Reset"; a tap sets turn to 0, then sets t1 to 5 minutes, then sets t2 to 5 minutes.

monthnav m

program:

setting goal money = 500000
let have = sum(dep.amount all)
let p = clamp(have / goal, 0, 1)
row gap 3
  draw 40, 120 width 56
    rect 14, 6, 12, 90 stroke ink thick 2 radius 6
    circle 20, 104, 12 fill red
    rect 16, 100 - 92 * p, 8, 4 + 92 * p fill red
  stack grow gap 1
    have big
    "of" goal faint tap edit goal
    round(p * 100) "% saved" bold
quick dep, amount, [5000, 10000, 25000]
form dep
list dep by day
remind "Add to the umrah fund" monthly on 1 at 10:00

- have is the total amount of dep.
- p is have divided by goal kept between 0 and 1.

- text: have.
- text: "of", goal; a tap opens goal for editing.

app "Rent sheet Plus" home slate
table flat name text, rent money
table paid flat ref flat
state m date = today
monthnav m
count(flat) - sum(flat, if(count(it.paid month of m) > 0, 1, 0)) "unpaid flats" head

program:
app "Mobile shop" phone plum
table accessory name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 5, price money?, kind pick Home|Work|Other, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(accessory, it.qty <= it.low)
short "accessories running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each accessory where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(accessory, it.qty * it.price) faint
form accessory
remind "Check your accessories" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Mobile shop, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- accessory: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 5; price: money, optional; kind: one of Home, Work, Other; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the accessory have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "accessories running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each accessory where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the accessory for editing; a swipe removes the accessory, with undo:
    - text: the name of the accessory.
    - text: the kind of the accessory.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the accessory.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the accessory to the qty of the accessory minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the accessory.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the accessory to the qty of the accessory plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the accessory.
- a form to add a accessory.
Reminder "Check your accessories" at 9:00 on Sat.

fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words

program:
app "Paint" pen ocean
setting cover num = 10 "Sq m per litre"
state len num = 4
state wid num = 3
state hgt num = 3
state opens num = 2
field len "Length (m)"
field wid "Width (m)"
field hgt "Height (m)"
field opens "Doors and windows"
let area = 2 * (len + wid) * hgt - opens * 1.8
"Wall area" round(area) "sq m" faint
let litres = area * 2 / max(cover, 1)
"Two coats need" round(litres * 10) / 10 "litres" big
let tins = if(litres / 4 = floor(litres / 4), litres / 4, floor(litres / 4) + 1)
"Buy" tins "tins of 4 litres" head
describe:
Paint, in the ocean colours.
You can change: "Sq m per litre": number, starts at 10.
Works out:
- area is 2 times the result of len plus wid times hgt minus opens times 1.8.
- litres is area times 2 divided by the larger of cover and 1.
- tins is litres divided by 4 when litres divided by 4 is litres divided by 4 rounded down, otherwise litres divided by 4 rounded down plus 1.
Remembers while you use it: len, starting at 4; wid, starting at 3; hgt, starting at 3; opens, starting at 2.
Shows:
- a box to fill in len, labelled "Length (m)".
- a box to fill in wid, labelled "Width (m)".
- a box to fill in hgt, labelled "Height (m)".
- a box to fill in opens, labelled "Doors and windows".
- text: "Wall area", area rounded, "sq m".
- text: "Two coats need", litres times 10 rounded divided by 10, "litres".
- text: "Buy", tins, "tins of 4 litres".

state flip bool = no

form card, "Add card"

program:
app "First aid kit" pill plum
table supply name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 2, price money?, kind pick Home|Work|Other

short "supplies running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)

    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
